name: cloud-native-aws-serverless
description: Use when the user asks about AWS Lambda internals, Firecracker microVMs, the execution environment lifecycle, concurrency limits, event source mappings, function URLs, layers, or Lambda timeouts. Produces correct Lambda function design and configuration. Not for cold-start tuning (use cloud-native-serverless-cold-starts) or Step Functions (use cloud-native-serverless-orchestration).
